A blanket swap skips the existing-directory restriction path when OwnerAuthorityStateFile first writes. The original tests do not assert root modes, but exact setup/native path preservation is preferable to assuming it is dispensable.

Its initial directory is absent; its existing-directory test is already0500. It does not force tightening a preexisting0755 root. Do not cite it as that exact proof.
reject_plain_temp_subdirectory_swap.separate_secret_boundary: ApprovalSecretFileTests asserts approval-secret root0700/file0600 and refuses writable directories/symlinks. ApprovalSecretFile has its own permission implementation; these are not proof that OwnerAuthorityStateFile calls PrivateStorage correctly.

However the uniform Directory.CreateDirectory-return proposal preserves that input too and avoids a mixed conversion.

poll600_assessment.boundary_math: Current cycles start at activation time t0 through t599, add1second after every cycle and end exactly t600, the original PendingPairingLifetime. The final consumed request is issued t599 with expiry t719, so remains within its2-minute lifetime at restart. Pending-at-restart is issued t600 and is usable in the original store. poll600_assessment.why65_is_not_identical: 65 one-second cycles do cross terminal cap64: the65th immediate replay triggers first removal of an older consumed record.600 repeats trimming536 times and spans10minutes of signed traffic.65 alone ends t65 before original pairing expiry. There is no implemented numeric600 branch, but the existing stress/time input is different and not selected away for a speed-only edit.
poll600_assessment.postloop_jump_risk: Setting clock directly to pairing.ExpiresAtUtc after65 cycles restores t600 and fresh pending-at-restart timing, but moves oldRequest from t64/expiry184 to an already time-expired request at restart, unlike the original t599/expiry719 request. Current production keeps consumed state and only expires Pending, so refusal still passes; this does not establish equivalence against a nonce-resurrection regression that incorrectly reopens a consumed request as Pending, where natural expiry could conceal the error.
poll600_assessment.preloop_jump_alternative_not_selected: Moving the omitted535seconds before the65-cycle loop would keep final consumed request and pending timestamps identical, but removes signed traffic across the first535seconds and repeated native eviction cycles. It requires additional clock manipulation and separate review/measurement; no selected proposal here.
